title: Steering Live Asides & Returning to the Thread

sections.content:
You know *por cierto*, *a propósito de*, *dicho sea de paso* and *volviendo a lo que decíamos* from B2 Unit 28, and *al margen de* from B2 Unit 27. In a live formal speech, a brief aside can make an address feel spontaneous and fluid, provided the speaker signals both the exit and the return.

To open a brief spoken aside from the lectern, speakers use *abro un paréntesis para…* ('let me make a quick aside to…') or *al margen de este punto* ('setting this point aside for a moment'). When closing it, signal the return cleanly with *cierro el paréntesis*, *retomando el hilo* ('picking up the thread again') or *volviendo al eje central*.

Avoid conversational *por cierto* in solemn addresses: it sounds abrupt, as if you had forgotten a detail. A good digression lasts one or two sentences and ends by recapping or synthesising the main line.

sections.title: Formal digression & return cues
rows: *Abro un breve paréntesis para aclarar este dato.*
*El informe, dicho sea de paso, puede consultarse hoy mismo.*
*Cierro el paréntesis y vuelvo al eje central de la alocución.*
*Retomando el hilo, conviene recapitular dos ideas clave.*

items.spanish: Abro un breve paréntesis para agradecer a quienes organizaron esta alocución.
items.english: Let me open a brief aside to thank those who organised this address.

items.spanish: Al margen de esa digresión espontánea, el argumento central sigue intacto.
items.english: Aside from that spontaneous digression, the central argument remains intact.

items.spanish: Retomando el hilo, quisiera sintetizar las tres propuestas principales.
items.english: Picking up the thread again, I would like to synthesise the three main proposals.

items.spanish: Cierro el paréntesis para recapitular de modo fluido el punto anterior.
items.english: I close the aside in order to recap the previous point smoothly.

sections.content: Signal the return explicitly (*retomando el hilo*, *volviendo al eje central*): leaving a digression unclosed makes the audience lose track of your main point. Never use *además* to signal a side remark — *además* adds a main point.
